title: fix(app-shell): Studio holds a dashboard widget whose binding was emptied, as it holds an absent one (objectui#11951)
body:
Fixes #11951

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

On Studio's Interfaces page, removing a dashboard widget's last measure in the widget inspector no longer sends the widget with `values: []` and draws the spec's red refusal before the author can pick another measure. The widget is held the way objectui#11910 holds a new, unbound widget: nothing is sent, a neutral line names what it needs ("Not saved yet: Values (measures) on the widget “Pipeline” needs a value."), the inspector shows "Required" under the measures, and Publish refuses while it is held. Picking a measure lets the next autosave go.

- **The predicate.** `widgetMissingInputs` in `studio-design/metadataError.ts` now reads a binding input as unset when it is absent, an emptied list (`dimensions`, `values`) or a cleared name (`dataset: ''`); before, only absent counted. Nothing else is unset: a list holding a blank member or a name of spaces is a value, and the spec's verdict on it stands.
- **A refusal that turns on an unset sibling.** The spec reports one dimension verdict at `values`: two measures on a `scatter` with no dimension are refused at `values`. When a filled binding input is refused, the predicate asks the spec again with each unset sibling set to a stand-in name. If that clears every issue at the filled input, the sibling is the input the widget needs. The stand-in is never written anywhere. No list of rules lives in Studio: the spec judges both parses.
- **The inspector.** No change. `DashboardWidgetInspector` already reads `widgetMissingInputs` for its "Required" rows, so the row shows under an emptied measure list and, for the scatter, under the dimensions. The pillar pins check this.
- **Finished but wrong is still sent.** A widget the spec refuses for anything else is sent, and its refusal shows the red strip as before: a wrong dataset name beside an emptied list, two measures on a metric or a pie (no dimension would satisfy the spec there), an off-spec type.

## Measured: the installed spec's verdict per binding input and state

`@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 `DashboardWidgetSchema`, asked of each state. The pins pair every row with the spec's `DashboardSchema` verdict on the same dashboard.

| input | state | spec | Studio |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | absent | refused at `dataset` (invalid_type) | held (objectui#11910) |
| `dataset` | cleared `''` | refused at `dataset` (too_small, invalid_format) | **held** (new) |
| `dimensions` | absent or emptied, one measure, any type | accepted | saved at once |
| `dimensions` | absent or emptied, two measures on `scatter` | refused at `values` (custom, measure arity) | **held for Dimensions** (new) |
| `values` | absent | refused at `values` (invalid_type) | held (objectui#11910) |
| `values` | emptied `[]` | refused at `values` (too_small) | **held** (new) |

Zone 2 readings:
- Hypothesis 1 held: `values: []` is a `too_small` at single-segment `values`. `values: ['']` is **accepted** by the spec, so it is not held. Holding it would be stricter than the contract.
- Hypothesis 2 was partly falsified. Emptied dimensions parse fine with one measure, which is every case except one: on `scatter`, the one type the picker offers whose arity turns on a dimension, two measures and no dimension are refused, at `values`. Per the ruling's intent (an emptied binding is never autosaved as a refused shape), that state is held for Dimensions. On the metric family and on `pie` / `donut` / `funnel`, two measures are refused whatever the dimension, so those stay finished but wrong and are sent.
- The inspector cannot write `dataset: ''`: its combo commits a cleared pick as absent. The cleared state is still held when a stored body carries it.

## Tests

All runs are at `9658d100` (the branch head, after merging `main` `d7e9e9ab`) unless a run names another commit.

- `metadataError.heldWidget-11910.test.ts`: a new `describe` (objectui#11951) walks each input × state above, plus the controls (a wrong dataset name beside an emptied list, two measures on a metric or a pie with the dimensions emptied, a dataset name of spaces). 11910's pin "an empty measure list is a value, not an absence: not held" pinned the exact branch this card removes, so it is replaced by its opposite there.
- `InterfacesPillar.heldWidget-11910.test.tsx`: a new `describe` drives the real inspector's remove buttons. It removes a metric's last measure (held, no save, no red strip, the line and the "Required" row name the measures, then a picked measure sends a body `DashboardSchema` accepts). It removes a one-measure bar's last dimension (saved at once, accepted). It removes a two-measure scatter's last dimension (held, the "Required" row under the dimensions). Control: a widget with a wrong dataset name is sent when its last measure is removed, and the red strip shows.
- Narrowed run, 44 files: every app-shell test file that names `DashboardWidgetInspector`, `metadataError`, `dashboardHeldEdit` or `widgetMissingInputs`, or that mounts `StudioDesignSurface` / `InterfacesPillar` and mentions a dashboard. Result: `Test Files 44 passed (44)`, `Tests 460 passed (460)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` runs `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` and exited 0, after the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` build closure. `--listFilesOnly` shows both touched test files are in the test project.
- eslint on the 3 touched files: 0 errors, 0 warnings. `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape`, and `check-changeset-presence` all exit 0. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` reads NOT GOVERNED.

### Reverse verification

The fix was committed first. Each leg went through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which needs its anchor to hit and checks the blob after the mutation and again after the restore. Every restore read blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
1. `bindingUnset` cut back to "absent only": **7 red**, exactly the emptied and cleared pins (5 predicate, 2 pillar). The controls and the absent-dimension scatter stayed green.
2. The sibling question disabled: **3 red**, the two scatter predicate pins and the scatter pillar pin.
3. The sibling blamed without asking the spec: **6 red**, every finished-but-wrong control, both of 11910's included. The controls can fail.

## Narrowing (declared)

- **vitest.** The whole-package run (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`, 1181 files) did not finish within the ~9-minute foreground cap (exit 124 under the verify lock, no result). The local run is narrowed to the 44 files above. The changed functions have exactly two callers: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`'s dashboard leaf hold and `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`. The full package run is CI's.
- **The narrowed set's one stray red.** A first, wider attempt (259 files naming "dashboard") also hit the cap. Before the cap it showed one red in an unrelated file, `AppContent.missingRecheckKeying.test.tsx` ("an app that resolves is never re-checked", alongside an ECONNREFUSED to port 3000). Run alone at the same tree it passes 8 of 8, so it is a load-dependent flake. It is not in this change's reach.
- **eslint.** The population is the root config's `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` minus its ignores. 3 files were counted by `--format json`. The config enables no type-aware linting (`tseslint.configs.recommended`, no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. `pnpm lint` over the tree is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- `values: ['']` and `dimensions: ['']` parse with the installed spec: member names are not checked at the widget, by the spec's own non-coverage note. Nothing in Studio writes them; the inspector only adds names from the dataset. Observation only, no card.
- 11910's pending changeset (`.changeset/11910-dashboard-widget-held.md`) stays true as written: "held only when the spec refuses it for nothing but a missing dataset, dimensions or measures" still describes the predicate. It is not edited here.
- Bundle: no new import; the predicate already imported the spec's `DashboardWidgetSchema`.

`.changeset/11951-emptied-binding-held.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch. Nothing is added to the package entry: no export, prop, type member or language-pack key.
